craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta of landing — rest, fulfillment, no-other-standing; autonomy dawning mid-proof. Ownership enacted: are shinings (identity, not belonging); autonomy dawns mid-line (shining alone is). Rejected: (a) belongs to shining → killed: belonging stated as identity is the move. (b) smoothing near-unreal → killed: asatkalpa load term. Read aloud: SO-these IN-ert-ONES … THROUGH-selves BOTH-own AND-oth-ER.

lines: So these inert ones, near-unreal in themselves, are shining's —
shining alone is — of its own self, through selves both own and other.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam ātmany asatkalpāḥ prakāśasyaiva santy amī jaḍāḥ prakāśa evāsti svātmanaḥ svaparātmabhiḥ

reads_against.argmap: What being have inert things? → Inert things have only borrowed being: shining alone is, owning both heaps — autonomy's first dawn.
c1_essence: What never stood cannot stand another: consciousness fits itself to this and I, orders inert selves by double certainty, and completes severed grasping in self-rest (vv10-15).
The same self twofold — breath-bound atom, unbroken whole — gathers in one continuous end-ground where nothing shows more inert than shining (vv16-18).
